g.text: Five SER models: accuracy at each vote rule
Correct predictions / auto-labelled samples; values are percentages.
Each colour is a different vote rule on the same 5 models.
n/a = group incomplete. — = no samples accepted, so accuracy is undefined. Bar labels round to whole percentages.
A stricter rule reduces automatic acceptance; its observed accuracy need not increase on every dataset.
